title: DigiTech PDS-1550 Distortion Analysis
summary: Analysis of the DOD/DigiTech PDS-1550 dual distortion: the metal channel turns out to be a Boss HM-2 in disguise; transistor gain stages, op-amp clipping and a BBD "double tracking" delay.

sources.title: Digitech PDS-1550 Programmable Distortion pedal analysis
sources.author: Tom Wiltshire (Electric Druid)
